problem: A production deployment can be technically ready while governance writeback, exact production identity, and capability-specific functional proof still need independent closure.
root_cause: Historically, 'zet live' could be interpreted too narrowly as deploy/publish. Powerhouse requires the production side effect and the governance/writeback lineage to close together, while still keeping each functional capability independently evidence-gated.

evidence.observed_rule: exact production deploy is deployment evidence; functional subchains and governance closure retain their own truth gates

prevention: Every material live promotion writes through to skills, agent/chat contracts, Brain learning, ledger/docs and System Map.
Production identity is recorded exactly and read back after write.
A deploy-ready provider state is never reused as proof for unrelated functional outcomes.
Subchains such as pricing interaction, locale roundtrip, social publication and connector readiness remain independently gated.
Future chats and agents inherit the same closure rule without requiring the user to repeat 'borg/leg vast/documenteer'.
truth_boundary: This learning proves the governance and production-identity closure rule; it does not promote any functional subchain without its own current readback.

explicit_projection_targets.rule: future chats and continuity/recovery agents inherit live-promotion governance closure without a repeated user request
